title: Stop Scrolling and Choose the Surf Pack
lessons: The player hears Teddy Swims's "Grab Life By the Claw" song playing down the beach and half the group already knows the words.
The player already buys White Claw and chooses a Surf variety pack built around more tropical flavor rotation.

text: Somebody down the beach has a speaker going, and half the group is already singing along before you even ask what song it is.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Everyone just knows this one?

entry-first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Teddy Swims. It's the song from my thing, second year now. I sponsored his tour, there's an acoustic set, there's a spot where his band turns an empty villa into a house party. I'm not going to pretend I didn't do all that.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: So the song is doing your marketing for you.

entry-first-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: The song was going to be stuck in your head anyway. I just made sure I was in the room when it happened.

entry-first-5.speaker: PLAYER
text: You really built a whole campaign around basic social behavior.

entry-first-6.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Basic social behavior is underrated.

choice-first.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Okay, the chorus is coming back around. You in or out?

choices.text: Honestly, that's closer to why people actually buy this.
The song was going to be stuck in my head either way. That's the whole trick.
I don't need a hard-seltzer name folded into a song I already like.

first-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Good. Sing the chorus, I'll take the credit.

first-1-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: You're very bossy for something breezy.

first-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Yeah. It is. It's a good song and I paid to stand next to it. Both of those are true and I'm only responsible for one.

first-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Fair. The song still works without me. Honestly, I'd like it even if I hadn't paid for it, which is sort of the problem.
You buy White Claw already. This time the cooler's got the Surf pack in it. Tropical everything.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: This whole pack looks like it wants sand in the cooler.

entry-return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Surf. I wasn't hiding the theme.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: And the point of four flavors?

entry-return-4.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: So the cooler doesn't have to agree on one. Somebody always wants the weird one. Now there's a weird one.

choice-return.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Grab whichever. Nobody's watching. Well, I am.

choices.text: I like having different options for a group.
A variety pack also makes the next can feel new, which makes it easier to keep going.
I'd rather bring one thing I actually like.

return-1.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Good. That's what it's for. A group, a cooler, four answers, no argument.

return-2.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Yeah, that happens. A new flavor feels like a new decision, even if it's the same can. I know that's not nothing.

return-3.speaker: WHITE CLAW
text: Then bring the one you like. The four-pack's not a test. I just like a full cooler.
